# National Restaurant Association

> The National Restaurant Association provides industry intelligence, educational resources, and advocacy support for restaurant operators and hospitality professionals.

The NRA serves as the central hub for restaurant industry information, offering membership benefits, educational programs like ProStart and HOPES, workforce development initiatives, and comprehensive resources on business operations, food safety, and sustainability. The organization aggregates industry trends, research reports, and best practices to support restaurant success across all operational areas.

## Key Topics

- National Restaurant Association
- ProStart
- HOPES
- ServSafe
- Restaurant & Hospitality Leadership Center
- State of the Restaurant Industry Report
- Workforce Engagement

## Core Resources & Membership

- [National Restaurant Association Homepage](https://restaurant.org): NRA homepage featuring industry reports, culinary forecasts, and member resources
- [Member Categories & Benefits](https://restaurant.org/membership/member-benefits): Membership categories and benefits including NRA Show and Expert Exchanges
- [Products & Research](https://shop.restaurant.org/find-products): Product catalog featuring industry reports, data abstracts, and trend analysis

## Education & Learning Hub

- [Education & Resources](https://restaurant.org/education-and-resources): Hub for articles, podcasts, webinars, reports and guides on restaurant operations
- [Learning Center](https://restaurant.org/education-and-resources/learning-center): Learning resources on business operations, food safety, and workforce engagement
- [Resource Library](https://restaurant.org/education-and-resources/resource-library): Articles on food trends, restaurant risk, best practices, and economic indicators

## Business Operations & Management

- [Business Operations](https://restaurant.org/education-and-resources/learning-center/business-operations): Guides on technology, supply chain, management, and kitchen/dining operations
- [Tech & Innovation](https://restaurant.org/education-and-resources/learning-center/business-operations/tech-innovation): Restaurant technology, digital transformation, POS systems, and 5G/IoT resources
- [Marketing & Sales](https://restaurant.org/education-and-resources/learning-center/business-operations/marketing-sales): Marketing strategy, loyalty programs, and customer engagement resources
- [Sustainability](https://restaurant.org/education-and-resources/learning-center/business-operations/sustainability): Tools and resources for sustainable seafood, waste reduction, and green sourcing
- [Preparedness & Business Continuity](https://restaurant.org/education-and-resources/learning-center/business-operations/preparedness): Disaster preparedness and business continuity guides for weather and utility disruptions
- [Immigration Enforcement Compliance](https://restaurant.org/education-and-resources/learning-center/business-operations/immigration-enforcement): Compliance guides and legal resources for immigration enforcement and ICE raids

## Workforce Development & Engagement

- [Workforce Engagement](https://restaurant.org/education-and-resources/learning-center/workforce-engagement): Recruitment, training, and development resources including ProStart and HOPES programs
- [Education & Scholarships](https://restaurant.org/education-and-resources/learning-center/workforce-engagement/education-and-scholarships): ProStart, HOPES, and apprenticeship programs with scholarship funding
- [Restaurant & Hospitality Leadership Center](https://restaurant.org/education-and-resources/learning-center/workforce-engagement/restaurant-and-hospitality-leadership-center): Leadership training and talent retention resources for hospitality industry
- [Recruitment Best Practices](https://restaurant.org/education-and-resources/learning-center/workforce-engagement/recruitment): Hiring practices and diversity-focused recruitment guides for restaurants
- [Diversity, Equity & Inclusion](https://restaurant.org/education-and-resources/learning-center/workforce-engagement/diversity): Diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives and multicultural leadership resources

## Food Safety & Nutrition

- [Food & Nutrition](https://restaurant.org/education-and-resources/learning-center/food-nutrition): Food safety, menu trends, nutrition, menu labeling, and FDA compliance guidance

## Support & Contact

- [Contact Us](https://restaurant.org/about-us/contact-us): Contact information and office locations for NRA and affiliated organizations
